1 days ago 🚨 Police seek tips after purse robbery in Georgetown
Delaware State Police are investigating a robbery that happened Thursday, September 24, 2026 around 9:30 p.m. on Helen Street in the Fishhook Mobile Home Park in Georgetown .
Two unknown Black male suspects wearing dark clothing (one with a mask ) walked up to a 78-year-old woman as she got out of her car at home, pushed her , stole her purse , and ran off. The woman was not injured .
Troopers from Delaware State Police Troop 4 Criminal Investigations Unit are working the case.
If you have any information, call Detective R. Horton at (302) 752-3807 , send a private Facebook message to Delaware State Police , or contact Delaware Crime Stoppers at 1-800-847-3333 .
If you or someone you know is a victim or witness of a crime and needs support, call the Delaware State Police Victim Services Unit / Delaware Victim Center 24/7 at 1-800-VICTIM-1 (1-800-842-8461) or email DSP_VictimServicesMail@delaware.gov .
